paragraphs.text: Norreen was the fighter wife of Garth One-Eye . She was born Rakel in the Benalish clan Tarmula on Dominaria .

Norreen had a seven-pointed star tattooed on her left forearm, a mark of the Benalish clan Tarmula. She had black hair that she wore short-cropped in her youth and long and wavy after she became a mother. After her torture, she was webbed with white scars. As a warrior, she wore a black leather jerkin and tight-fitting trousers. She was considered an average swordsman in Benalia.

Norreen was born Rakel of Clan Tarmula in Benalia . Her caste was ruling and scheduled to rotate to the bottom, meaning any upper-level man could demand anything from her. Knowing that Sabriam , a man whom she'd refused to marry, would take advantage of this, given the opportunity, she chose to become a hero who served above Benalia's caste system. To that end, she served as squire to the warlord Alaqua. In a battle in the Red Iron Mountains, Alaqua was killed, and Norreen was struck by three arrows and knocked unconscious by a dwarven axe. Transported in a wagonload of bodies to Estark , she took fourteen months to recover in a hospital. Once she'd recovered, Noreen chose to win glory by fighting in the Arena rather than return to Benalia and submit to a man.

Here she met Garth, whom she quickly fell in love with. After the Time of Troubles , he said he would give up planeswalking to live with her. The two retired in the countryside of Gish , with their child Hammen , to grow a vineyard. However, Garth found leaving behind his powers much harder than he had thought, and started journeying between the planes again. It was during one of his absences that Norreen and Hammen were kidnapped and brought to Benalia .

Norreen was charged with assassinating Gull and Greensleeves but instead became Gull's lover and a commander in their army, disciplining the force. Once she considered her work complete, she attempted to take her own life. She was captured and tortured before being saved by Lily and Gull. The army escaped to the Whispering Woods , where Garth reappeared. The wizard recanted his planeswalker spark, reconciling with his family and returning to their vineyard.
